title: Implement the obligation-ledger and evaluation-result contracts (Phase 1 vertical slice)
objective: Implement contracts/obligation-ledger.schema.json and contracts/evaluation-result.schema.json exactly matching docs/contracts/obligation-ledger.md and docs/contracts/evaluation-result.md, approved in docs/architecture/ADR-0002-obligation-and-evaluation-contracts.md under decisions D1A (fixed closed status enum: open, in-progress, satisfied, regressed, abandoned), D2A (baseline comparison and false-halt/late-halt cost fully absent from Phase 1, deferred to Phase 2), D3A (CLI verb evaluate <trace-path> <ledger-path>, two positional arguments), D4A (ADR-0002 extends ADR-0001 via a single Status-line append only), and D5A (this single task contract). Implement ObligationLedgerValidator (fixed five-value status enum, unique/non-empty obligations, dangling eventId/obligationId rejection, traceId match, abandoned-terminal ordered-position rejection covering both a strictly-greater dereferenced-sequence violation and a same-eventId higher signals-array tie-index violation, 16 MiB size-limit reuse) by refactoring or sharing TraceValidator's internal structural-validation helpers rather than duplicating them, and the deterministic Evaluator implementing exactly the classification table and precedence rule fixed in docs/contracts/evaluation-result.md, including the absence of any n>1, s1=abandoned branch. Add EvaluationResultNormalizer producing the exact canonical property order and byte-idempotent serialization fixed in docs/contracts/evaluation-result.md, and the CLI evaluate verb with 0/1/2 exit codes matching validate. Add synthetic fixtures under fixtures/obligations/valid and fixtures/obligations/invalid covering: partial progress, single-signal progress, no-progress/stagnation, repeated-status stagnation, regression via rank decline, regression via explicit regressed signal, abandoned-as-stagnation, insufficient-evidence (an obligation with zero signals, not a dangling reference), malformed JSON (exit 2), unsupported ledger version, duplicate obligation id, empty obligations array, dangling eventId, dangling obligationId, mismatched trace/ledger identity, a signal following a terminal abandoned signal via strictly greater dereferenced sequence, and a signal following a terminal abandoned signal via an identical eventId tie broken by a higher signals-array index, plus golden evaluation-result outputs for every valid fixture. Extend tests/ProgressTrace.ConformanceTests/Program.cs to assert full fixture discovery, schema-to-runtime parity, evaluation determinism, repeated-normalization idempotence, and exact diagnostic codes for every invalid fixture including both abandoned-terminal violation fixtures. Extend .github/workflows/ci.yml to run the new evaluate acceptance commands and both schema-validity checks alongside the existing Phase 0 build/conformance/validate/format steps. Introduce zero new third-party package dependencies. Do not modify contracts/trace-envelope.schema.json, docs/contracts/trace-envelope.md, docs/architecture/ADR-0001-contract-first-modular-monolith.md, docs/architecture/ADR-0002-obligation-and-evaluation-contracts.md, docs/contracts/obligation-ledger.md, docs/contracts/evaluation-result.md, tasks/phase-1-obligation-evaluation.json, or docs/product-brief.md; only the allowed_paths below may change. Do not start if this task contract or the architecture documents it depends on fail validation, or before Dragos has approved decisions D1A-D5A recorded in docs/architecture/ADR-0002-obligation-and-evaluation-contracts.md; if any decision is rejected, stop and request architecture replan instead of guessing. After the builder completes, Hermes independently re-executes every acceptance command below with zero writable repository paths, audits that only allowed_paths changed and that the frozen Phase 0 contract remains byte-identical to main, and assembles an evidence packet and diff bundle written outside the repository. Antigravity then reviews only that evidence packet and diff bundle, with no repository, git, build, run, or write tool of any kind, and returns a structured verdict as JSON on stdout for Hermes to persist. Dragos reviews the diff, evidence packet, and verdict, and owns the final human integration decision via the normal PR flow; no automatic merge is permitted, and no role edits another role's owned artifacts.
